name: Prejudice
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to reject prejudice by loving others as Christ loved us, without favoritism or partiality. Jesus instructs us not to judge others superficially but to exercise righteous judgment, emphasizing the importance of loving our neighbor as ourselves. Peter affirms that God shows no partiality, and Paul encourages humility, warning against thinking too highly of oneself. Together, these verses reveal that prejudice contradicts the heart of the gospel and that Christians must pursue love and sober judgment rooted in grace.
